flow.description: A flow: steps of code that run when an event fires, with the tools they may use

description.description: What the flow does, in a sentence — the heading of its steps

host.description: The object whose event starts it, from the app: app, db

usr_id.description: The owner: its tools run with this user's rights

tools.description: The tools it may call, by name, as a JSON array

steps.description: The steps as a JSON array: { description, fn } with fn as source, or { description, debounce: { ms, by } }

test.description: Only *_get tools take effect, the other calls are recorded

log_id.description: The request that last changed it
